entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2887731882922767744: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 27628: distance 26.731 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.003), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 26.731 +/- 0.08 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 36.9038 +/- 0.1345 mas (same row, RUWE 2.32), 274.4 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 54.452, 404.600 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2887731882922767744 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 10.487 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 27628: radius 10.487 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 46.438 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.054) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4656 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 27628: effective temperature 4656 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.069).
